hypothesis: For old rows the usr.public.users value is NONE for loyalty_tier, and user-profile-sync cannot parse the null.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis blames null loyalty_tier values in old rows, not the subject-level compatibility override set to NONE that let an incompatible schema register. It does name user-profile-sync, so the consumer is the first failing layer, but the root cause sits in the data, not in schema-registry.
